component.name: PetalLink
component.summary: Synchronize Huawei Cloud Drive with a local directory
将华为云空间与本地目录双向同步

description.p: PetalLink is an open source desktop client that connects directly to Huawei Cloud Drive through its REST API. It maps cloud files to a local directory and keeps changes synchronized in both directions.
PetalLink 是通过华为云 REST API 直连的开源桌面客户端，可将云端文件映射到 本地目录并保持双向同步。

ul.li: On-demand downloads and local placeholder metadata
Real-time local file monitoring and cloud change polling
Persistent transfer queue and conflict handling

description.p: Current stable macOS baseline and initial Linux porting base.
